title: Chapter Review: The Data Link Layer

questions.prompt: A packet goes from a laptop over WiFi to a home router, then over Ethernet to the ISP. What happens to it at the router?
options: It's taken out of the WiFi frame and put into a new Ethernet frame for the next link
It's converted into a TCP segment

questions.prompt: Which layers does a NIC implement?
Put the Ethernet II fields in order.
options: Destination MAC, source MAC, data, EtherType, FCS
Destination MAC, source MAC, EtherType, data, FCS
Source MAC, destination MAC, EtherType, data, FCS
EtherType, destination MAC, source MAC, FCS, data

questions.prompt: What's the largest data field in a standard Ethernet frame, in bytes? (a number)
What's the minimum Ethernet frame size, in bytes? (a number)
What does the first half of a MAC address identify?
options: The network the device is on

questions.prompt: A MAC address beginning 6e: is locally administered.
Why is MAC filtering weak protection on its own?
options: MAC addresses can be spoofed or cloned from a trusted device

questions.prompt: A single parity bit misses which errors?
options: Any even number of flipped bits

questions.prompt: D = 1101 and G = 1011. What are the 3 CRC bits?
Ethernet asks the sender to retransmit a frame that fails its FCS check.
Which family of multiple access protocols never has collisions, but wastes the share of any idle node?
What's slotted ALOHA's maximum efficiency, as a percentage? (a whole number)
After its 2nd collision in a row, an Ethernet NIC chooses K from which set?
Why does WiFi use CSMA/CA rather than CSMA/CD?
options: A wireless node can't hear collisions while it's transmitting

questions.prompt: A switch receives a frame for a MAC address it hasn't learned yet. What does it do?
options: Floods it out of every port except the incoming one
Holds it until the host speaks

questions.prompt: Which switch becomes STP's root bridge?
options: The one with the most links
The one with the lowest bridge ID: lowest priority, then lowest MAC address
The one with the highest MAC address

questions.prompt: Which STP port state adds MAC addresses to the table but doesn't forward frames yet?
What does ARP do?
options: Maps a domain name to an IP address
Maps a local IP address to a MAC address

questions.prompt: arp -a shows an entry at 0:0:5e:0:1:33. What is it?
options: A VRRP virtual router MAC address, shared by redundant gateways

questions.prompt: Hiding a WAP's SSID is a strong security measure.
Which hypervisor feature reclaims memory a VM isn't using? (two words)
